PIC0.PROPER REDUCES TO UniversallyClosed ALONE, AND THE OTHER TWO CONJUNCTS WERE ALREADY PROVED IN THE FILE, SITTING UNUSED NEXT TO THE SORRY.

THE FINDING. mathlib IsProper (Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Morphisms/Proper.lean) is a THREE-field structure:
    class IsProper : Prop extends IsSeparated f, UniversallyClosed f, LocallyOfFiniteType f
QuasiCompact is NOT a field -- the module docstring says so explicitly ("we do not require quasi-compact, since this is implied by universally closed"). And Picard/Pic0AbelianVariety.lean had ALREADY PROVED two of the three, before this run, as theorems adjacent to the sorry:
  * Pic0.isSeparated -- the clopen inclusion Pic0 -> Pic is a monomorphism hence separated, composed with picScheme_isSeparated from the strengthened HasPicScheme existential;
  * Pic0.locallyOfFiniteType -- first conjunct of IdentityComponent.isFiniteTypeGeometricallyIrreducible.
It even had Pic0.quasiCompact, with a docstring correctly noting it is not needed for the proper assembly. So the sorry was standing next to two thirds of its own proof.

WHAT IS LEFT: UniversallyClosed only, now named Pic0.universallyClosed. And it is further reducible: the already-proved Pic0.universallyClosed_of_baseChange (Stacks 02KS fpqc descent, via MorphismProperty.of_pullback_snd_of_descendsAlong) takes universal closedness of the base change to k-bar and returns it over k -- so Kleiman s projectivity argument is only needed over an algebraically closed field.

INTERACTION WITH THE STANDING CAVEAT I-0074 (Caveat 2), which matters for how to attack it: mathlib v4.31 has NO quasi-projectivity vocabulary, which is exactly why PicScheme.smoothProperQuotient is weaker than Kleiman lm:qt and unprovable as stated. Kleiman th:qpp&p s first conclusion (Pic0 is quasi-projective) needs that missing vocabulary. So the expected route is base change to k-bar, NOT formalising quasi-projectivity from scratch.

GENERALISABLE LESSON, the reason this is worth a memory rather than just a commit: before attacking a sorry whose conclusion is a mathlib STRUCTURE (IsProper, IsFinite, IsAffine...), enumerate that structure s fields and grep the file for each one. A multi-field target can be two thirds discharged by theorems already in the same file. The relevant check is "how many fields does the conclusion have, and which are already present", and it took minutes.

MEASUREMENT TECHNIQUE, applicable to any such reduction: with the sorry-bodied gate ASSUMED as a hypothesis (so typeclass synthesis cannot contribute) and the reduced input SUPPLIED, print axioms; ALSO print a control (the unreduced theorem at the same binders) which must still report sorryAx. Probe alone proves nothing -- it cannot distinguish "no leak" from "too weak to see one".
